search_boundary: Absence findings are limited to the documented routes and the 2026-07-28 snapshot; they are not proofs of worldwide nonexistence.

entries.finding: The inverse-based CPOBC and atomisation equations are visually verified. Eq. (112) uses Q_n, while literal Eq. (113) prints Q_(n+1).
entries.claim_boundary: Keep derived/appendix and literal source branches separate; do not assert an author-confirmed typo.

entries.finding: One Q_k is assumed to commute with every Q_n in the full family, implying commutativity of Q and A.
entries.claim_boundary: The lemma is not automatically triggered by a finite Q_1 through Q_4 calculation.

entries.finding: Appendix Eq. (165) starts from a Pauli-proportional four-generator family and obtains inconsistency under the paper's invertibility assumptions.
entries.claim_boundary: This is not a classification of arbitrary invertible 2 by 2 tuples.

entries.finding: Page 19 contains an isolated sentence that transition operators may not themselves be invertible, despite the surrounding nonsingular condition and later explicit inverse formulas.
entries.claim_boundary: The v0.3.4 paper-strong profile retains nonsingularity and records the sentence as a source-prose inconsistency.

entries.finding: For a 2 by 2 matrix X over a commutative coefficient ring, adj(X)=tr(X)I-X and X^-1=adj(X)/det(X) where det(X) is invertible.
entries.claim_boundary: The identity does not prove any project-specific determinant factor is nonzero and does not justify deleting a singular locus.

entries.finding: Known criteria, invariants, and canonical-form methods can audit reducibility and deduplicate project solutions.
entries.claim_boundary: They do not impose GC, MSR, or CPOBC and do not decide the project-specific existence problem.

entries.topic: trace invariants and generic 2 by 2 tuple reconstruction
entries.finding: Trace-word invariants and irreducible-character reconstruction are prior art.
entries.claim_boundary: Generic or stable-point reconstruction does not classify all degenerate and non-semisimple GL(2) tuples.

entries.topic: matrix-coefficient realizations of noncommutative rational functions
entries.finding: General noncommutative rational matrix-evaluation and minimal-realization theory is established.
entries.claim_boundary: A free-skew-field realization is not the same as the fixed-d=2 rational matrix DAG over the project's commutative coordinate ring.

entries.topic: noncommutative rational realizations around a matrix centre
entries.finding: Matrix-centred realization theory and its related continuation are established prior art.
entries.claim_boundary: They do not identify the 22 project-specific B-inverse auxiliaries or prove forward/reverse finite-CPOBC equivalence.

entries.finding: Localization and standard-basis computation in localized rings are standard exact methods.
entries.claim_boundary: Method availability is not a certificate for a v0.3.4 denominator inventory or chart.

entries.finding: Exact Groebner algorithms for saturation and colon ideals are prior art.
entries.claim_boundary: Their existence does not validate an unrecorded saturation predicate, unit-ideal certificate, or completeness claim.

entries.topic: fixed-d=2 rational reconstruction of the finite v0.3.3 CPOBC DAG
entries.finding: No audited primary source supplies this project-specific reconstruction.
entries.claim_boundary: Both construction and proof obligations remain project work.

entries.finding: No audited source proves equivalence between full finite operator assignments and the proposed fixed-d=2 rational scheme.
entries.claim_boundary: A forward reduction alone licenses only a necessary condition; a reverse reconstruction alone licenses only sufficiency.

entries.finding: The Q_n and literal Q_(n+1) branches must be compiled independently; the literal n=4 instance introduces Q_5.
entries.claim_boundary: Q_5 may not be silently equated with Q_4 or deleted.

entries.topic: complete exact S1/S2/S3 elimination for n<=4
entries.finding: The literature provides tools but no project-specific complete elimination.
entries.claim_boundary: Every stratum, residual-gauge chart, denominator predicate, and unresolved component must be recorded.
